dedupe_keys.name: crexwet and crexwet synth multilingual flood and wildfire tweet corpora crexdata

description: CREXWET is a multilingual corpus of tweets labelled for relevance to flash floods or wildfires, built to train weather emergency detection models. It contains about 627,000 unique sentences (266k German, 223k English, 91k Spanish and 46k Catalan) from past flood and wildfire incidents and unrelated periods, with fields for an index id, the tweet id, language, a fire, flood or none label and a Cleanlab label-quality score; it is split into 592,704 training and 34,722 test instances, where test labels were human reviewed and test incidents do not appear in training. The companion CREXWET-SYNTH corpus holds about 37,000 synthetic tweet-style texts generated with Gemma 3 27B and Mistral Small 24B to augment real data, with the generating model and prompt category recorded. Both were produced by the Barcelona Supercomputing Center in the EU CREXDATA project and published on Zenodo in December 2025 as downloadable ZIP files under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: CREXWET releases tweet ids, so texts must be rehydrated from the platform, training labels are machine generated, and coverage is limited to four languages and two hazards. It supports emergency response situational awareness and crowdsourced event detection for resilience studies; a related record is the Global Flood Monitor.
name: CREXWET and CREXWET-SYNTH multilingual flood and wildfire tweet corpora (CREXDATA)
notes: Reference: Orama, J. A., Juvillà Garcia, M., Melero, M. (2025). CREXWET: CREdata-Weather-Emergency-Twitter. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.17950332
